brief: critic with fresh context, W1-13 round 2
findings: start: pgrep -c headless_shell = 12, loadavg 9.85 -- ABOVE the binding cap of 8. Doing read/analyse phase first per AGENT-PROTOCOL.

READ-PHASE F1 (STRONG, needs live confirm): _spendSouls(attrId) in game/src/engine.js:3345 does prog.attributes[attrId] = (prog.attributes[attrId] || 10) + 1 with NO validation. The level-up screen's row list is game/data/progression/attributes.json (TEN ids: strength endurance agility speed vigour willpower intellect hist-bond personality luck). The DEFAULT character (sim/state.js:214) has SIX and they are Souls names: vigour endurance strength dexterity intelligence faith. So dexterity/intelligence/faith are NOT on the screen and cannot be raised, while 7 of the 10 rows show a constant 10 for an attribute the character does not have, and confirming one MINTS it at 11.

READ-PHASE F2: the builder's own headline artifact reports_runs/W1-13-R2/levelling-loop.json shows this happening: hearth-archon raised endurance (real), hearth-lilmoth raised AGILITY (new key), hearth-gideon raised SPEED (new key). Two of the three demonstration spends bought an attribute the character did not have, and both were scored pass:true with souls_matches_cost:true.

READ-PHASE F3: consumers of progression.attributes by NAME across game/src: derivePools() reads vigour/endurance/willpower/strength only; character/reaction.js reads personality; engine.js:1945 reads personality+luck; quest/gate.js reads faction favoured_attributes and quest requires.attributes. faction-gates.json names agility/endurance/hist-bond/intellect/personality/strength/willpower; quest requires name strength/hist-bond/personality/willpower/intellect. SPEED IS NAMED BY NOTHING - no pool, no reaction, no faction gate, no quest requirement. Souls spent on speed buy a level number and nothing else.

READ-PHASE F4: game/data/states/*.json declare 18 spawn entries and ZERO of them carry any of the six S5 classification flags. The 'world can write it in DATA' route the builder added (engine.js:661-667) has no user in shipped data. The statblock route (2 bosses) and the hearths.json fog_gates[].boss route ARE real.
READ-PHASE F5: M-D1's constants ARE fixed (trials_* are now rows.length - failLeg.length). population_* remaining as rows.length is legitimate.

READ-PHASE F6: journey-run.mjs:986-990 calls led.ok('m_jrn06_summary', ...) UNCONDITIONALLY, even when runJrn06 returned early with unmeasurable:true. On an unmeasurable run the summary line still reads [OK] with checks:{}. The refusal is recorded in the ledger but the summary surface a human reads still says OK.

READ-PHASE F7: TREE IS DIRTY. Another agent is mid-edit on game/src/harness/api.js (adds factionDiscipline/factionReadmit) plus tools/analysis/build-viability.mjs and tools/harness/w1-26-opening.mjs. Per RI-MTH04 'How we lose' #5 every measurement I take is on a dirty tree and must be declared. Note the new code introduces a THIRD gold holder: engine.magic.gold, mirrored from sim.progression.gold.

MEASURED, PROBE A1 (reports/runs/critic-W1-13-R2/probe-a1.json): the level-up screen draws TEN attribute_row elements - strength endurance agility speed vigour willpower intellect hist-bond personality luck - while the character on the shipped 'default' state carries SIX: vigour 10 endurance 20 strength 12 dexterity 12 intelligence 10 faith 10. Seven rows are for attributes the character does not have and each draws a constant 10. Three of the character's real attributes (dexterity, intelligence, faith) are NOT ON THE SCREEN and cannot be raised. Confirming 'speed' or 'agility' MINTS the key at 11 and the screen's own preview for both reads derived: [] - it promises nothing and delivers nothing.

MEASURED, PROBE A1, THE BIG ONE: the CONTROL FAILED. Spending on 'endurance' - the row whose drawn preview promises 'stamina max 120 -> 122.5' - raised the level 1->2 and took 418 souls, and stamina_max stayed at 120 after closing the screen and stepping. hp_max 620 and focus_max 94 also unmoved across three levels.

MECHANISM (source, to be confirmed live by probe B): Engine.applyDerivedPools() at game/src/engine.js:948 opens `const ch = this.sim.character; if (!ch) return null;`. _spendSouls sets sim._poolsDirty and engine.js:3968 calls applyDerivedPools - which bails on every session that has not been through character creation. That is every named state, every scenario, and the shipped 'default' state the ROUND-2 BUILDER'S OWN levelling probe used. The header comment on applyDerivedPools describes this exact failure as already fixed once: 'round 1 composed all of this correctly and then wrote none of it anywhere the fight could see, which is why VIGOUR 6 and VIGOUR 18 both reported hp_max 620'.

AGGREGATION IS RUNNING and has already produced a FAIL the standalone probes did not: 'FAIL m_d8_second_death - M-D8 exactly one bloodstain, always; the first is destroyed'. jrn06 log prints only failures, so a quiet log is a clean run.

THE TREE BROKE UNDER ME MID-RUN. At ~16:5x another agent (W1-SOULS) committed game/src/engine.js line 375 `this.sim.souls = new SoulsSystem(this.data.enemies)` with NO IMPORT, and every browser launch now dies with 'ReferenceError: SoulsSystem is not defined' at Engine._boot. Probe A1 was taken before this; probe B could not launch. Declaring under method_deviations. Its own comment is worth recording: 'until this line existed soulsHeld had exactly one producer in the whole build (death.js handing back a bloodstain you had already paid for), so _spendSouls() and RI-PRG01's 139-row curve were an unfundable sink' - i.e. a SECOND agent has independently found that souls have no earn path.

*** THE AGGREGATION LANDED *** run_id 20260807T162212Z-jrn06-death-s4711-57e6a3, wall_ms 595538 (~9.9 min), page_errors 0, git.dirty TRUE. reports/journeys/critic-w1-13-r2-jrn06/journey.json. TOP-LEVEL ok: FALSE. 37 instruments; two carry pass:false - m_d8_second_death and m_d14_stain_visibility - and NEITHER was caught by any standalone probe. This is exactly the shape the brief predicted: ten checks confirmed individually and never together.

AGGREGATE FAILURE 1 - M-D14 THE BLOOM CANNOT BE SEEN. daylight at 12 m: visible from 1 of 8 bearings. dark at 6 m: 3 of 8. In every failing view px == control_px == 195, i.e. the frame with the bloom in it is pixel-indistinguishable from the frame turned 180 deg away. RI-JRN06 M-D14 requires visible at 12 m and at 6 m in the dark. The run back is the piece's whole premise and the thing you walk back to is invisible from five of eight approaches.

AGGREGATE FAILURE 2 - M-D8 ON A DOUBLE DEATH THERE IS NO STAIN AT ALL. 6 doubled deaths, every one stains_before 1 -> stains_after 0, second_stain_souls null. The item's text is 'exactly one bloodstain, always; the first is destroyed'; the check's predicate is stains_after === 1. The second death destroys the first bloom and creates none.

THE ENTRY-SCREEN GATE FIRED FOR REAL, ON THE REAL RUN: m_jrn06_entry_screen_closed reports ui_mode_on_entry 'inventory', ui_mode_after_close 'world', advanced 5. journey-run.mjs IS leaving the inventory screen open before jrn06 begins. The builder's gate is load-bearing and this run is the proof. CREDIT to the builder.

AND THE SAME OPEN SCREEN BREAKS AN EARLIER CHECK THE BUILDER DID NOT FIX: control_observed is unmeasurable - 'the player did not move between [2766.5,2.68,5011] and [2766.5,2.68,5011] after 60 frames of forward input'. first_control and m4_clause1 fall over with it. So the open inventory screen is still silently freezing journey-run.mjs's OWN pre-legs; the builder guarded jrn06 and left the upstream defect in place.

M-D2 IS STILL A CONSTANT IN THE AGGREGATE: placement_rules {death_point: 20}, max_offset_m 0, mean_offset_m 0. The fall / last-grounded / fog-gate rules the builder fixed and demonstrated in a STANDALONE probe still never fire once in twenty journey deaths. Round 1's '0.000 m describes the probe' criticism is unmoved by the aggregation.

M-D10 IS ALSO A CONSTANT: n 20, max_frames 0 - every one of the twenty deaths is instantaneous because it is damagePlayer(1e5), so 'HP reaches 0 within 12 frames of the last hit' is measuring the harness verb.

A FAILING CHECK IS STILL LOGGED [OK]. put() calls led.ok() unconditionally and only ADDS a separate log('FAIL ...') line. Both failing checks appear in the ledger dump as '[OK ] m_d8_second_death ...' and '[OK ] m_d14_stain_visibility ...'. journey.ok is false, so the run does fail overall, but the per-check surface a human reads says OK for a check that failed.

PROBE B MEASURED AND FALSIFIABLE (reports/runs/critic-W1-13-R2/probe-b.json), TWO ARMS, ONE BROWSER: arm 'no-character' (the shipped 'default' state, which is what the round-2 builder's own levelling probe used): VIGOUR 10->18 for 5,418 souls, hp_max 620->620; ENDURANCE 20->28 for 11,661 souls, stamina_max 120->120; WILLPOWER for 20,573 souls, focus_max 94->94. sim._poolsDirty stays TRUE forever. arm 'with-character' (setCharacter first): same spends, hp_max 300->508, stamina_max 104->130, focus_max 30->56. THE CONTROL GOES GREEN. The instrument works; the build does not.
